title: Admin Product Management Flow
interaction_flow: Admin → AddProductSrv: POST /AddProductSrv (multipart: name, type, info, price, quantity, image)
AddProductSrv → HttpSession: getSession() → check usertype=='admin', username, password
alt [not admin or session expired]: AddProductSrv → Admin: redirect login.jsp?message=Access Denied!
AddProductSrv: extract Part image → part.getInputStream() → prodImage:InputStream
AddProductSrv → ProductServiceImpl: addProduct(prodName, prodType, prodInfo, prodPrice, prodQuantity, prodImage)
ProductServiceImpl: new ProductBean(prodId, prodName, prodType, prodInfo, prodPrice, prodQuantity, prodImage)
ProductServiceImpl → Database: PreparedStatement INSERT INTO product VALUES(pid,pname,ptype,pinfo,pprice,pquantity,image)
ProductServiceImpl → AddProductSrv: return status:String ('Product Added Successfully...' or error)
Admin → UpdateProductSrv: GET/POST /UpdateProductSrv (pid, name, type, info, price, quantity)
UpdateProductSrv → HttpSession: getSession() → check usertype=='admin', username, password
alt [not admin or session expired]: UpdateProductSrv → Admin: redirect login.jsp with error
UpdateProductSrv: new ProductBean() → set prodId, prodName, prodType, prodInfo, prodPrice, prodQuantity
ProductServiceImpl → Database: PreparedStatement UPDATE product SET pname,ptype,pinfo,pprice,pquantity WHERE pid=?
alt [k>0 AND prevQuantity < updatedQuantity (restock)]: ProductServiceImpl → DemandServiceImpl: haveDemanded(prevProductId) → demandList:List<DemandBean>
ProductServiceImpl → MailMessage: productAvailableNow(userName, userFName, prodName, prodId)
ProductServiceImpl → Database: PreparedStatement SELECT image FROM product WHERE pid=?
alt [image == null]: ShowImage: load noimage.jpg via ImageIO → fallback byte[]
key_relationships: ProductServiceImpl depends_on DBUtil (static utility for Connection)
ProductServiceImpl depends_on DemandServiceImpl (restock notification path only)
ProductServiceImpl depends_on UserServiceImpl (get user first name for email)
ProductServiceImpl depends_on MailMessage (send restock notification email)
DBUtil uses singleton Connection (static conn field, lazy init from application.properties)

ProductServiceImpl: addProduct(String prodName, String prodType, String prodInfo, double prodPrice, int prodQuantity, InputStream prodImage): String
ProductBean: ProductBean(String prodId, String prodName, String prodType, String prodInfo, double prodPrice, int prodQuantity, InputStream prodImage)
getters/setters for: prodId, prodName, prodType, prodInfo, prodPrice, prodQuantity, prodImage

important_notes: doPost delegates to doGet in all three servlets — single entry point logic
Session auth guard: usertype must equal 'admin'; username and password must be non-null
AddProductSrv uses @MultipartConfig to handle file upload (image as InputStream from Part)
updateProductWithoutImage: if restocked (prevQuantity < newQuantity), triggers demand notification loop via DemandServiceImpl + MailMessage
updateProduct (with image) exists but UpdateProductSrv only calls updateProductWithoutImage
ShowImage returns fallback noimage.jpg if DB image is null
DBUtil.closeConnection(Connection) is effectively a no-op (commented out body) — connection stays open
DB table: product(pid, pname, ptype, pinfo, pprice, pquantity, image BLOB)
IDUtil.generateId() creates the unique product ID on add
